films.title: Raised arms in the workshop
films.description: R.O.B. stands on its tracked base with both articulated arms raised in a home workshop.

films.title: Head movement with both arms raised
films.description: R.O.B. demonstrates head movement while holding both robotic arms raised beside its torso.

films.title: Camera-head rotation
films.description: R.O.B. rotates its camera head above a tracked base while its arms remain lifted.

films.title: Reaching with both arms
films.description: R.O.B. extends both multi-jointed arms outward and adjusts their position during a movement test.

films.title: Coordinated arm movement
films.description: R.O.B. bends both arms inward through a coordinated sequence while facing the camera.

films.title: Loading the planter
films.description: A builder places a decorated planter box across R.O.B.'s arms and adjusts it into position.

films.title: Turning while supporting the planter
films.description: R.O.B. supports a broad planter filled with green foliage while its camera head turns.

films.title: Holding the planter steady
films.description: R.O.B. holds the planter steady before a person passes close in front of the camera.

films.title: Camera pan above the leaves
films.description: R.O.B.'s camera head pans above the foliage while the planter remains balanced across its arms.

films.title: Front view behind the planter
films.description: R.O.B. faces forward behind a dense planter, with its head assembly visible above the leaves.

films.title: Can recycling demonstration
films.description: ROB lifts and repositions a can and releases it above the recycling bucket.

films.title: Can pickup
films.description: A close view of the can pickup sequence.

films.title: Vertical recycling reel
films.description: The shorter vertical edit of the can-handling demonstration.

films.title: Torso turn with a can
films.description: The torso turns while ROB holds the can.

films.title: Coke pouring demonstration
films.description: A supervised workshop demonstration of pouring from a can.

films.title: Pouring practice
films.description: Workshop footage of the pouring practice sequence.

films.title: Holding through the turn
films.description: ROB turns its torso while holding a red Coke can, with its tracked base and open opposite gripper in view.

films.title: A lightsaber at Maker Faire
films.description: ROB holds a blue lightsaber upright near visitors and astromech droids inside the exhibition hall.

films.title: From the booth to the exhibition hall
films.description: ROB rolls along the outdoor aisle beside the Orbitus canopy toward the exhibition-hall doorway, accompanied by an operator.
